"""Close completed D458 analysis domains and verify the curated evidence."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment_retry14_baseline')
RAW=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/p2_backend/d458_full_w0'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts import ieee_tc_preflight as p

load=lambda path:json.loads(path.read_text())
identity=p.scope_identity(p.cg_path().name)
with (RAW/'finalize_identity.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(identity,f,indent=2)
closed=[]
for name in ('review_identity.json','curation_identity.json'):
    expected=load(RAW/name)
    owner=p.scope_identity(expected['unit'])
    assert owner==expected and p.scope_still_owned(owner)
    group=Path(owner['path'])
    members={str(f):f.read_text().split() for f in group.rglob('cgroup.procs')}
    assert members and all(not rows for rows in members.values())
    resources={k:(group/k).read_text().strip() for k in
        ('memory.peak','memory.events','memory.swap.current')}
    assert p.scope_still_owned(owner)
    subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','stop',owner['unit']],check=True)
    after=subprocess.check_output(['systemctl','--user','show',owner['unit'],'-p','ActiveState','--value'],text=True).strip()
    assert after=='inactive'
    closed.append(dict(identity=owner,recursive_cgroup_procs=members,
        actual_recursive_procs_empty=True,resources=resources,after=after))
checked={}
def visit(value):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        if isinstance(value.get('path'),str) and isinstance(value.get('sha256'),str):
            path=Path(value['path'])
            assert checked.get(str(path),value['sha256'])==value['sha256']
            if str(path) not in checked:
                assert p.digest(path)==value['sha256'],path
                checked[str(path)]=value['sha256']
        for child in value.values():visit(child)
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for child in value:visit(child)
for path in OUT.glob('*.json'):
    visit(load(path))
for row in load(OUT/'postrun_analysis_sources.json')['scripts']:
    assert hashlib.sha256(row['content'].encode()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
    assert Path(row['path']).read_text()==row['content']
report=load(OUT/'matched_comparison.json')
prior=load(ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/main_comparison/d454_7b_w0/comparison.json')
assert report['previous_six_system_results']==prior['results']
assert report['reference']==prior['reference']
assert report['matched_contract_sha256']==prior['matched_contract_sha256']
assert len(report['same_backend_output_audits']['PrimeLoRA_D371']['changed_request_ids'])==220
assert len(report['same_backend_output_audits']['ElasticLocality_D453']['changed_request_ids'])==204
assert not subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
seal=p.verify_seal(Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment/results/ieee_tc/slora_qualification/d435_20261011/protected_before.json'))
assert seal['pass'] and seal['entry_count']==147
with (OUT/'final_delivery_check.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(dict(passed=True,verified_refs=len(checked),protected=seal,scope=identity,
        closed=closed,previous_six_rows_unchanged=True,reference_unchanged=True,
        source=dict(path=str(Path(__file__)),sha256=p.digest(Path(__file__)),content=Path(__file__).read_text())),f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,verified_refs=len(checked),protected=147,closed=len(closed),scope=identity)))
